chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Shave the hair of the abdomen for both the male and the female.

key_terms.اِحْلِقُوا: shave; an imperative command to remove hair
key_terms.رَسُولُ: the Messenger, referring to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say about shaving abdominal hair for men and women?
ai.summary: This hadith gives an instruction concerning personal cleanliness for both men and women. It reflects Prophetic guidance on bodily grooming and hygienic etiquette.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.261 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Shave the abdomen hair for both males and females." (And in another version, it includes armpit hair).
